item.statement: For every valid invocation, each logical output element odata[y*pitch+x] with 0<=x<width and 0<=y<height is the exact binary32 source element at column floor_mod(x+shiftX,width) and row floor_mod(y+shiftY,height); elements outside the logical region are not part of the result.

plans.objective: Verify the exact output mapping of the future Ascend-C shiftPitchLinear operator against an independent host floor-mod oracle.
plans.observation: Obtain the future Ascend-C candidate artifact and run the harness on Ascend 950PR; capture the odata buffer returned to the host.
plans.pass_condition: Pass iff every logical odata element (0<=x<width, 0<=y<height) is bitwise identical to the corresponding host gold element.
plans.setup: Build a host harness that fills the source logical region with a distinct known binary32 pattern per cell, computes gold[y*pitch+x]=src[floor_mod(y+shiftY,height)*pitch+floor_mod(x+shiftX,width)] for all logical cells using mathematical floor-modulo, and launches the candidate with width=2048, height=2048, pitch=2048, shiftX=5, shiftY=7 on Ascend 950PR with CANN 9.1.0-beta.1.
